subtitle_manipulation: A modern, simple, fast, and secure web interface for subtitle manipulation and translation tools.
select_tool_desc: Choose the subtitle tool you want to use from the navigation menu or cards above.
upload_file_desc: Upload your subtitle or video file and configure the tool settings.
get_results_desc: Download your processed subtitle file with the results.
time_shift_desc: Shift timestamps in subtitle files to fix synchronization issues with videos.
paste_srt_content: Paste your SRT content here or upload a file...
paste_srt_desc: Paste the content of your SRT file here or upload a file
optionally_view_video: Optionally View Video - to help you determine timestamps
shift_seconds_desc: Shift all timestamps by this number of seconds (positive = later)
first_entry_starts_at_desc: Align the first subtitle to this start time
mkv_to_srt_desc: Extract subtitles from MKV files and convert them to SRT format.
translate_desc: Translate subtitle files using AI models with customizable instructions.
chunk_size_desc: Number of subtitle units per API request
model_id_desc: Model identifier for the API (use LiteLLM formatting)
output_file_path_desc: If left blank, output filename will be derived from input filename
time_shift_success: Your subtitle file has been processed successfully.
translate_success: Your subtitle file has been translated successfully.
convert_desc: Convert subtitle files between different formats (SRT, VTT, ASS, TTML, and more).
paste_subtitle_content: Paste your subtitle content here or upload a file...
paste_subtitle_desc: Paste the content of your subtitle file here or upload a file
output_format_desc: Select the format to convert to
preserve_formatting_desc: Keep original text formatting (HTML tags, whitespace, etc.). Uncheck to normalize text.
convert_success: Your subtitle file has been converted successfully.
auto_sync_desc: Fix subtitle drift by applying time-varying offset correction for frame rate issues.
autosync_desc: Fix subtitle drift by applying time-varying offset correction. Use this when subtitles start in sync but gradually drift out of sync over time (e.g., due to frame rate differences).
two_point_desc: Specify two points: where subtitles are correct and where they have a known offset.
offset_at_desc: Time where you know the offset
multi_point_desc: Specify multiple sync points for complex drift patterns.
known_drift_desc: Apply a known drift rate from common frame rate conversions.
example_drift: Subtitles correct at 0:30, 5 seconds late at 10:00
example_multi: Multiple sync points for complex drift
tip_drift: Drift is common when video and subtitles have different frame rates
tip_watch: Watch the video and note timestamps where subtitles are correct vs. wrong
tip_positive: Positive offset means subtitles appear LATE (after the audio)
tip_negative: Negative offset means subtitles appear EARLY (before the audio)
download_file: Download the corrected SRT file above
rename_file: Rename it to match your video file name
play_video: Place it in the same folder as your video and play
test_sync: Test the sync - if still off, adjust the parameters and try again
track_management_desc: List, extract, and merge subtitle tracks from video files.
list_tracks_desc: Upload a video file to see all available subtitle tracks.
extract_tracks_desc: Extract one or all subtitle tracks from a video file.
merge_subtitles_desc: Combine multiple subtitle files into one.
please_upload_at_least_two: Please upload at least two subtitle files
